name: finite_optimizer_state_pause
mutation: For 800 consecutive optimizer hooks set current group learning rates to zero and detach current parameter gradients; restore the exact prefix-observed group rates before the following update.

mechanism_state_change.optimizer_moments_and_step: held because parameters have no current gradients
mechanism_state_change.parameter_versions: held because learning rate is zero
mechanism_state_change.decoupled_weight_decay: held because the parameter update is skipped and learning rate is zero
mechanism_state_change.RNG_and_data_order: continue to evolve; the graph shows a complete 317-sample training batch each update, so ordering is not claimed to be frozen

stability_effect_rationale: The intervention pauses every operative formation and relaxation-oscillator variable rather than selectively reducing stability reserve. After restoration, the same reserve law resumes 800 optimizer updates later, so the stability class is unchanged while its optimizer-step intervals are delayed by approximately the pause.
